basic_info.description: Recently updated flooring and move-in ready! Luxury condominium in a modern building that combines classic urban architecture with modern design. This spacious one-bedroom, one-bathroom unit features a private balcony and an open floor plan, making it feel larger and brighter. It comes with a large storage unit in the building, perfect for suitcases or larger equipment, and one parking spot available for an additional fee.    Building amenities include a fitness center, exercise studio, conference room, four high-speed elevators, a courtyard with a fountain, a barbecue area, and a reflecting pool. With a walk score of 96, a transit score of 100, and a bike score of 99, this location offers an abundance of restaurants, shops, and entertainment all within a short distance. Additionally, tech bus stops are conveniently located right in front of the building, making it perfect for commuting to the South Bay and Peninsula.
